protocol.description:
The permission_authentication protocol allows to request user-interactable permission popups.
This protocol must be guarded behind the "tavernkeep" permission.
permission_authentication is an exclusive protocol. It must be exposed with the exclusivity flag.

object.name: hp_hyprtavern_permission_authentication_manager_v1
object.description: This object is a core manager object bound upon creation.

s2c.name: availability

description.summary: Availability of the permission authentication manager

s2c.description:
This event is emitted on bind, and every time this changes.
The event describes whether asking for permissions is available. Certain things (e.g. DISPLAY / WAYLAND_DISPLAY env) can enable / disable the prompts from being shown.

object.name: hp_hyprtavern_permission_authentication_transaction_v1
object.description: This object represents a permission transaction.

c2s.name: set_app_name

description.summary: Set an app name for this transaction

c2s.description: Set an app name for this transaction. This should be a human-readable name.

c2s.name: set_app_identifier

description.summary: Set an app identifier for this transaction

c2s.description:
Set an app identifier. This can be a path, a flatpak ID, etc.
It's not meant to be human-readable.

c2s.name: ask_permission
c2s.description: Ask the user for a permission. This may be done only once.

s2c.name: permission_result
s2c.description:
Response from the manager with the result.
This object may not be reused, you must not call anything that isn't destroy after this event.
